description.ko: Shuffle SOAR 워크플로를 트리거하고 실행 결과를 수집하는 보안 자동화 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description.en: Security automation agent that triggers Shuffle SOAR workflows and collects execution results. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

name: Shuffle SOAR
description_en: Shuffle SOAR workflow execution bridge. Triggers workflows via webhook, maintains an in-memory execution log, and accepts result callbacks from Shuffle. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

Shuffle result callback — updates execution status
